data.body:
Independent adversarial regression-safety validation completed for all eight supplemental removal claims. The validator repeated semantic and raw dynamic/monkeypatch scans, history/ticket reads, and recensused origin/main 5ff99170b5d0 (98 commits beyond audited HEAD); no candidate was reconnected or materially changed.

Corrected conclusion: NONE is safe as a blind deletion.

- Reconciler family must split: a standalone child may remove only dead ConcurrencyEvent, Result, rebase_retry, and _handle_failed_write_result. RescheduleError/EXIT_RESCHEDULE/catches remain until the approved reconcile/reconcile-check compatibility removal. Preserve snapshot_head, ReconcileLockLost -> RESCHEDULE, canonical bridge exit 0, store RebaseGuard exit 75, and migrate or retain decoding for persisted "reconcile-check" gate-ref values.
- pass4_coach is safe only after three tests, model inventories, and docs move to workflow ops/shared review_kernel.coach.
- _guard_passes is safe only after its fail-closed oracle moves to _guard_scoped/interpreter execution.
- failure_usage is safe only as a complete implementation rename to run_shape with six live callers, tests/docs, and JSONL equivalence migrated.
- _is_transient_add_error aliases are safe after tests target gitutil and retry/corruption negative controls remain.
- _referencing_commit_exists wrappers are safe after scanner tests move to _referencing_commits and lifecycle close coverage remains.
- Jira _fit_description has no executable consumer and is safe with prose/test ownership corrected to OutboundFieldMapper/codec composition.
- Jira _direct_rest_put has no executable consumer and is safe with mock/inventory/comment cleanup while _direct_rest_put_raw exact-body/auth/retry contracts remain.

Read-only baselines: 593 focused tests passed in 74.72s across all eight areas; 27 Jira raw-PUT endpoint/body/auth/retry tests passed in 3.35s. These are pre-change contract baselines, not a deletion simulation; every implementation ticket must recensus on its own base and run post-change/full gates. No public reuse export, MCP schema, persisted event, or Jira wire contract needs to change if these boundaries are honored. Full evidence and commands are recorded in the report/tools log. No product or tracker state was modified by the validator.
